director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CavdFhhfMVhuGjp7tP

Ruling: what a viewer sees on a dashboard whose every dataset tile the server refuses (project discussion thread 「决定仪表盘全部无权限时的显示」) · letter **A** · maintainer 「A」 2026-10-29T21:41Z

The maintainer's own ruling, given in the project thread at 2026-10-29T21:39Z on the review thread's six-section analysis (`/mnt/project-files/decisions/27491-仪表盘全部无权限-呈批.md`, recommendation A, which the card thread's report `6508422494` and `domain:ui#2`'s brief also recommended). Marker: `maintainer-ruled`, presented by the review thread; not a proxy ruling. It settles the collision between triage `6495993447` and the #26971 hide rule the spec documents.

## What was re-verified (code read at `d93d9be5` on `main`)

- The blank is the #26971 rule, not a swallowed 403. `DatasetWidget.tsx` L972–974 classifies the refusal (`classifyLoadError(e) === 'forbidden'`) and calls `onForbidden`; `DashboardRenderer.tsx` L393 records the tile in `refusedTiles` and L1105 returns `null` for it outside design mode. The CRM `pipeline_dashboard` (`examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts`) has six widgets, all on `opportunity_metrics`, so a member refused that dataset is left with the header over nothing. The card thread's unit equivalent (real definition, real adapter, fetch stubbed to 403) and its ablation of L1105 confirm there is no second source.
- The spec says so: `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` L1095–1102 ("A viewer who may not read a tile's data does not see the tile … is left out of the dashboard for that viewer") and the `requiresObject` describe at L1160–1163, landed by #27068 / PR #27252.
- The all-refused case was a KNOWN gap, not an oversight: PR #27065's Acceptance notes read "If every tile of a dashboard is refused, the viewer sees the header and an empty grid; no message is drawn for that case."
- The triage sentence "Render each widget's refusal with the existing #26971 tile refusal state" presumed that state is a visible face. For a viewer it is the tile left out, so the sentence cannot be met literally; its second half ("no new dashboard-level error path") is read here as "reuse an existing face, invent no error machinery".
- The face to reuse exists: `DashboardView.tsx` L238–243 draws `dashboard-access-denied` (lock icon, `dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle`, the server's sentence) when the by-name read of a dashboard is refused (objectui#12112).
- Option C is real but elsewhere: a dashboard's `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066, #22611/#22639) IS enforced by the server (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `audience-permission` arm: not listed, refused by name), and the nav item guard applies `requiredPermissions` too. `examples/app-crm` declares neither on `pipeline_dashboard` nor on `nav_pipeline_dashboard` (`crm.app.ts` L33). `navObjectReadGate.ts` prunes only `type: 'object'` nav entries, which is why the CRM landing says nothing is available while the sidebar still offers Pipeline.

## Governing text

- Spec `dashboard.zod.ts` L1095–1102 and L1160–1163: a refused dataset tile is left out for that viewer outside design mode; the server's refusal is the only verdict; the renderer never guesses a permission.
- #26971 Acceptance 1 and triage `6456651336` (no new widget key); PR #27065 Acceptance notes (all-refused = empty grid, noted).
- Triage `6495993447` on this card, read as above.
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12 (a wrong state is refused loudly, with a prescription; never silently).

## The ruling: A

The per-tile hide stays as the spec states it. When, outside design mode, the renderer has at least one refused tile and no widget left to draw, it draws one canvas-level no-access panel in the same face `DashboardView` already uses for a refused dashboard. A partial refusal keeps today's behaviour (the refused tiles leave, the rest reflow, no message).

Fixed here:

1. **Trigger**: `!designMode && refusedTiles.size > 0 && <zero widgets rendered>`. Not "every dataset tile refused": a dashboard that still has a non-dataset widget (text, iframe, object-bound inline) draws those and no panel; a dashboard with zero widgets to begin with draws no panel (`refusedTiles` is empty).
2. **Face**: the `Empty` composition of `DashboardView`'s `dashboard-access-denied` (lock icon; title `dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle`; one NEW message key `dashboard.allWidgetsForbiddenMessage`, en "You don't have permission to view the data behind this dashboard.", in all ten locales under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`); `data-testid="dashboard-all-widgets-forbidden"`. Header title, description and "Refresh All" stay as they are (a refused tile is not re-queried until remount, #27065; unchanged).
3. **Pins** (one new test file beside `DashboardRenderer.refusedTile-26971.test.tsx`): all refused → panel, no tile title, no per-tile face; partial refusal → no panel, readable tile present; CONTROL design mode, all refused → no panel, every tile's objectui#10899 face present; CONTROL non-refusal failure (400) on every tile → no panel, error alerts present.
4. **Surface**: `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`, the new test, ten locale files, changesets `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. ⛔ No spec change, no `DatasetWidget` change, no `DashboardView` change, no `examples/**`.
5. **C runs beside A, not instead**: `domain:ui#2` files one S card in the app lane: `examples/app-crm` declares `requiredPermissions` on `pipeline_dashboard` and on `nav_pipeline_dashboard`, with a capability one of the CRM sales permission sets actually grants; acceptance = a member's sidebar has no Pipeline entry and a direct link gets `dashboard-access-denied`. Not paired with this PR.
6. ⛔ Not: per-tile faces when all are refused (B: contradicts the spec sentence and makes a tile's face depend on its siblings); any client-side permission guess that hides a nav entry or a dashboard before the server answers (D); any change to the partial-refusal behaviour or its 26971 pins.

### Why A, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (≥50%).** The rule "a refused tile leaves" went through a seat, a triage and a maintainer merge (#26971 → #27065 → #27252) and is now spec. A leaves it alone and fills the one set it never covered: nothing left. Mainstream BI does the same — a report whose data you cannot read says so once. B reopens a three-day-old spec sentence for an edge and adds a sibling-dependent state; C is the app author's duty and does not cover the renderer.
- **② Measured business pull.** Found by the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough (#27377 W3-UX); every member without a permission set hits it on any dashboard whose tiles share one dataset, which the CRM example's Pipeline is.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** A fails loud: one panel, no metadata read, no client guess; it appears only when the renderer has drawn nothing. B's state machine gains a dimension (the last refused tile flips its siblings). C depends on every app author remembering the gate; a forgotten gate falls back to today's blank.
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** A: one package, one branch, one key, S (precedent #27065, +185/−1). B: two lanes. C: an app-lane PR outside this card's file surface.

Only-① pick: A. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Effort for the chosen letter: **S**.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 长远：「读不到就拿掉」已经 #26971 → #27065 → #27252 三道进了 spec，A 不动它，只补它没覆盖的空集（一个都没剩时说一句）；B 为边角重开刚合入的 spec 句子，且卡片的面取决于兄弟；C 是应用作者的事，盖不住渲染器。
② 拉动：18.3.0 RC 走查实测（#27377 W3-UX）；每个没拿到权限集的成员，在任何「数据集全在同一对象」的仪表盘上都会撞到，CRM Pipeline 六块一个数据集就是。
③ 防错：A 响亮且只在渲染器确实一个都没画时出现，不读元数据、不猜权限；B 状态机多一维；C 靠作者记得声明门，忘了就回到空白。
④ 不扩散：A 一包一分支一键，S；B 两车道；C 应用车道另立卡。
Prior rulings read: #26971 triage `6456651336`、PR #27065 Acceptance notes、#27068 / PR #27252、objectui#12112（`dashboard-access-denied` 面）、objectui#10899（卡片自己的无权限面）、#22611 / #22639 / ADR-0066（仪表盘 `requiredPermissions`，服务器强制）；本卡：triage `6495993447`、Claim `6508167825`、报告 `6508422494`。

## Execution after the ruling

- The card stays `pm:dispatched` on `domain:ui#2`; the card thread resumes on `claude/project-thread-x22lgi` with `Ruling-ref: <this comment id>`, builds items 1–4 above, then gates, draft PR (Fixes #27491) and os-dev-report per the seat's flow; non-governed surface, lands after ACCEPT + PASS per the seat's flow.
- `domain:ui#2` files the C card (item 5) through the relay; its wording is that card's.
- Spec-lane hygiene, not this card: the JSDoc above `DashboardSchema.requiredPermissions` (`dashboard.zod.ts` ≈L1779, "including why it says the gate is not enforced yet") is stale — the describe already says the server enforces it. One sentence, to ride along with the next spec card.
- Not reopened: the per-tile hide; the 26971 pins; `DatasetWidget`'s own face; "Refresh All" behaviour on refused tiles.
